tasks.description: Implement data aggregation on the backend to provide fleet performance metrics, visualized on the dashboard with a Pie Chart for fleet status distribution.
acceptance_criteria: `totalFleet` must equal the number of car records returned by `Car.findAll()` inside `getFleetAnalytics`.
`availableCount` must count only car records where `availability_status === "Available"`.
`unavailableCount` must equal `totalFleet - availableCount`.
`availabilityRate` must equal `Math.round((availableCount / totalFleet) * 100)` when `totalFleet > 0`.
When `totalFleet > 0`, `averageDailyRate` must equal `Math.round(sum(price_per_day) / totalFleet)`, with missing, empty, or non-numeric `price_per_day` values counted as `0`.

When `totalFleet > 0`, `availableDailyRate` must equal the sum of `price_per_day` only for car records where `availability_status === "Available"`, with missing, empty, or non-numeric `price_per_day` values counted as `0`.
`averageFleetAge` must use only finite positive `model_year` values and equal `Math.round(sum(currentYear - model_year) / validYearCount)`.
`oldestModelYear` must equal the minimum finite positive `model_year`.
`newestModelYear` must equal the maximum finite positive `model_year`.
`expiredInsuranceCount` must count only parsable `insurance_validity` dates earlier than the server current date/time.
`insuranceExpiringSoonCount` must count only parsable `insurance_validity` dates from the server current date/time through 30 calendar days after it.
`brandDistribution` must be sorted by `count` in descending order.
`registrationCityDistribution` must be sorted by `count` in descending order.
Each returned object in `fuelTypeDistribution` must contain `fuelType`, `count`, and `percentage`, where `percentage` equals `Math.round((count / totalFleet) * 100)` when `totalFleet > 0`.
`totalSalesRevenue` must equal `SaleHistory.sum("price")`.
`totalVehiclesSold` must equal `SaleHistory.count()`.
When the analytics API returns `totalSalesRevenue: 12345`, the `/admin/dashboard` page must display `Total Sales Revenue` with the value `$12,345`.

When `statusDistribution` contains at least two statuses with non-zero counts, the `/admin/dashboard` page must display a fleet status chart with one visible legend row per returned status, and each legend row must show the status name, vehicle count, and percentage from the API response.

If there are zero car records, `totalFleet`, `availableCount`, `unavailableCount`, `availabilityRate`, `availableDailyRate`, `averageDailyRate`, `averageFleetAge`, `expiredInsuranceCount`, and `insuranceExpiringSoonCount` must return `0`.
If there are zero finite positive `model_year` values, `averageFleetAge` must return `0`.
If there are zero finite positive `model_year` values, `oldestModelYear` must return `null`.
If there are zero finite positive `model_year` values, `newestModelYear` must return `null`.
If `insurance_validity` is missing, empty, or unparsable, that car record must not increment `expiredInsuranceCount`.
If `insurance_validity` is missing, empty, or unparsable, that car record must not increment `insuranceExpiringSoonCount`.
If `statusDistribution` is an empty array and no analytics request error exists, the `/admin/dashboard` page must display `No fleet status data available.` and must not display a fleet status chart.
If `fuelTypeDistribution` is an empty array, the `/admin/dashboard` page must display `No fuel type data available.` in the Fuel Type Breakdown section.
If the analytics summary API request fails, the `/admin/dashboard` page must display `Unable to load fleet analytics. Select Retry to request the latest data.`.
After an analytics summary API request failure, selecting `Retry` on `/admin/dashboard` must send one additional `GET /api/cars/analytics/summary` request.
If `SaleHistory.sum("price")` returns `null`, `totalSalesRevenue` must return `0`.
